name: Meridian Perps (ExchangeGateway + merUSD)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: ExchangeGateway.owner() and merUSD.owner() resolve to the exact same bare EOA (real nonce 84) on both independent RPCs - one key controls the perps exchange and its own settlement stablecoin.
narrative.detail: A separately-checked LP vault has no exposed admin surface of its own (owner/curator/admin/manager/governance all revert) - all real authority here sits on the exchange gateway. Scored with the same convention already used for Curve DEX’s identical one-key-two-contracts pattern.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
